Summaries of every CSV in `data/`. Add files there, then run `just render`.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

# Paths are relative to the project root (execute-dir in _quarto.yml).
data_dir = Path("data")
frames = {path.name: pd.read_csv(path) for path in sorted(data_dir.glob("*.csv"))}

if not frames:
    print("No CSV files in data/ yet.")
else:
    print(f"Found {len(frames)} CSV file(s):")
    for name in frames:
        print(f"- {name}")
```

```{python}
for name, frame in frames.items():
    display(Markdown(f"## {name}"))
    display(Markdown(f"{len(frame):,} rows, {frame.shape[1]} columns"))

    missing = frame.isna().sum()
    missing = missing[missing > 0].sort_values(ascending=False)

    display(Markdown("### Preview"))
    display(frame.head())

    display(Markdown("### Column types"))
    display(frame.dtypes.rename("dtype").to_frame())

    display(Markdown("### Missing values"))
    if missing.empty:
        print("No missing values.")
    else:
        display(missing.rename("missing").to_frame())

    numeric = frame.select_dtypes(include="number")
    if not numeric.empty:
        display(Markdown("### Numeric summary"))
        display(numeric.describe().T)

    low_cardinality = [
        column
        for column in frame.select_dtypes(exclude="number").columns
        if frame[column].nunique(dropna=True) <= 12
    ]
    if low_cardinality:
        display(Markdown("### Category counts"))
        for column in low_cardinality:
            display(Markdown(f"**{column}**"))
            display(frame[column].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("count").to_frame())

    plot_columns = list(numeric.columns[:6])
    if plot_columns:
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            1,
            len(plot_columns),
            figsize=(3.5 * len(plot_columns), 3),
            squeeze=False,
        )
        for axis, column in zip(axes[0], plot_columns):
            numeric[column].dropna().hist(ax=axis, bins=20, color="#3d5a40")
            axis.set_title(column)
        fig.suptitle(name)
        fig.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
```
